maddeler.e: اِسْتَغْرَبَ • (istaḡraba) X (non-past يَسْتَغْرِبُ (yastaḡribu), verbal noun اِسْتِغْرَاب (istiḡrāb))
maddeler.t: From غَرُبَ (ḡaruba, “to be strange”) and غَرْب (ḡarb, “west”).
g: to find (something) weird, strange, odd, unusual, funny
to dismiss, to find (something) absurd, outrageous
to be Westernized, to adopt Western mannerisms or behavior
